errors.evidence: The description states that the 'Търговия' line has round markers, but there are no markers on any of the lines in the chart.
The value for 'Търговия' in 2004 is approximately 59.5%, not 60.0%.
The value for 'Търговия' in 2008 is approximately 54.5%, not 54.0%.
The value for 'Търговия' in 2011 is approximately 61.0%, not 62.0%.
The value for 'Търговия' in 2012 is approximately 58.5%, not 58.0%.

errors.text_span: спад до 64,0% през 2017 г., след което се възстановява до 64,0% през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The value for 'Търговия' in 2017 is approximately 63.5% and in 2019 is approximately 64.5%. The description incorrectly states both are 64.0%.

errors.text_span: Внос (сиво, пунктирана линия с кръгли маркери)
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates 'round markers' and fails to specify that the 'Внос' line is short-dashed, which is necessary to distinguish it from the 'Износ' line.

errors.text_span: Стойността започва в 2004 г. с 62,0% и се понижава до 52,0% през 2006 г.
errors.evidence: This description incorrectly mixes data from two different lines. While the starting value of ~62.5% is for 'Внос' (Import), the drop to ~52.0% in 2006 is a characteristic of the 'Износ' (Export) line. The 'Внос' line does not drop to this level.

This part of the description for 'Внос' is following the wrong line's data points and mixing them. The text describes a sequence of events that does not match any single line on the graph consistently.

errors.text_span: Износ (сиво, пунктирана линия с кръгли маркери)
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates 'round markers' and describes the line as 'пунктирана' (dotted/dashed) without specifying that it is long-dashed, failing to distinguish it from the 'Внос' line.
The value for 'Износ' in 2004 is approximately 57.0%, not 56.0%.
The 'Износ' line does not recover to 54.0% in 2007; it stays near its 2006 value of approximately 52.0%.
The value for 'Износ' in 2009 is approximately 58.5%, not 60.0%.
